Population increased in Surrey

The estimated population of Surrey in 2024 was 1,248,649 usual residents, a rise of 1.1% since 2023.

In the period from mid-2021 to mid-2024, the population estimate of Surrey increased by 3.5%.

Age profile of Surrey

The average (median) age stayed at 42.2 years between 2023 and 2024.

You can see how the age profile of Surrey has changed since 2011 in the population pyramid below.

sections.source: Office for National Statistics – Mid-year population estimates

sections.content:
By age category, Surrey's population of 1,248,649 usual residents was made up of:

  • 236,750 people aged 0 to 15 years, (19%)
  • 772,676 people aged 16 to 64 years, (61.9%)
  • 239,223 people aged 65 years and over, (19.2%)

    • Compared with England and Wales as a whole, Surrey has a similar proportion of people in these age categories.

Contributors to population change

We look at different flows of people into and out of areas and births and deaths to see what is driving population change in each area.

In Surrey, the largest contribution to population change in the year to mid-2024 was from net international migration.

sections.title: Contributors to population change in Surrey
sections.subtitle: How the population changed, by component

sections.content:
We estimate that, for Surrey, between 2023 and 2024:

  • More births than deaths increased the population of 625 people (0.1%). In total, there were 11,437 births and 10,812 deaths in Surrey.
  • Net internal migration (people moving to and from other areas in the UK) increased the population by 1,693 (0.1%). There were 77,432 people entering the area and 75,739 people leaving the area.
  • Net international migration led to an increase in Surrey's population of 11,002 (0.9%) as a result of 19,226 people entering the area and 8,224 people leaving the area.
  • Other change (which includes changes to armed forces personnel and prisoners) for Surrey was less than 0.1%.

Revisions to 2023 population estimates

We regularly revise our initial population estimates as we get more data and methods improve.

Our revised estimate for the population of Surrey in mid-2023 is 1,235,134.

Within this, international migration was revised upwards by 4,525 people and internal migration estimates were revised upwards by 1,938 people.

Overall, there was an revision upwards of 6,463 people.
